sentences.pause: Recording paused: a third person is in the call, or Darpana could not confirm who is, and the agreement covers two people. Both of you need to agree again before recording continues.
sentences.record: Both people on the agreement are in the call, so recording continues.
sentences.refuse: Recording cannot start: this platform does not tell Darpana who is in the call, so it cannot tell whether anyone beyond the two of you is listening. Use a platform that lists participants.
